title: 학력인정학교지정규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20080304:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 1, March 4, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (46) Omitted.
(47) Part of the Rules on Designation of Schools Recognized as Providing Academic Qualifications shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1) 2, paragraph (2) of the same Article, the portion of paragraph (3) of the same Article other than its subparagraphs, and Article 4 (1) and (2), "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology".
(48) through (63) Omitted.
